#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S6: run the new file in a scratch clone with the test map and breadth list of one commit (parent or ACT).
# Usage: bash s6_run.sh <commit-of-the-two-data-files>
set -u
WT=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-66c-tests
SCR=/tmp/gov-os-lead-W2-66c
CLONE=$SCR/td-clone
FROM=$1
rm -rf "$CLONE"
git clone --quiet "$WT" "$CLONE"
git -C "$CLONE" checkout --quiet w2/W2-66c-tests
git -C "$WT" show "$FROM:governance/project/test-map.yaml" > "$CLONE/governance/project/test-map.yaml"
git -C "$WT" show "$FROM:tests/optin-lifted-breadth.txt" > "$CLONE/tests/optin-lifted-breadth.txt"
echo "clone head: $(git -C "$CLONE" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD); data files from: $FROM"
git -C "$CLONE" status --short
cd "$CLONE" || exit 2
env HOME=$SCR/empty-home PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/usain/.local TMPDIR=$SCR PYTHONPATH=$CLONE/src \
  python3 -m pytest tests/acceptance/W2-66/test_w2_66_select_fixes.py -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  -o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed -m "not local_only" -rf 2>&1 | tail -n 60
